hero.title: Plan Your Financial Freedom
hero.line1: Confused about your financial planning? Don't worry.
hero.line2: Answer a few simple questions and get clear insights to take control of your future.

reachGoal.title: Can I reach my FFP goal?
reachGoal.description: Check if your current plan is achievable or if you're saving too little or too much.

timeline.title: When will I reach FFP?
timeline.description: Calculate the age you can achieve financial freedom.

spending.title: How much can I spend at FFP?
spending.description: Find out your safe monthly spending once you reach financial freedom.

savings.title: How much should I save?
savings.description: Calculate the required monthly savings to reach your goal on time.

charts.goalSubtitle: Compare projected wealth against the required wealth target at your selected FFP age.
charts.wealthRangeSubtitle: Shows lower, expected, and higher projected wealth through your selected FFP age.
charts.timelineSubtitle: Compare projected wealth against the age-specific wealth requirement to identify when financial freedom is achieved.
charts.timelineRangeSubtitle: Compare lower, expected, and higher wealth paths with the age-specific requirement to estimate when financial freedom may be reached.
charts.cashflowSubtitle: Projects the decline of retirement wealth over time based on your spending plan.
charts.cashflowRangeSubtitle: Shows lower, expected, and higher retirement wealth paths based on post-FFP investment returns.
